title: Tom's Pocket Money
text:
Tom gets pocket money every Saturday. He receives five pounds from his parents. He likes to save some money in a small box. This week he wants to buy a new book.

On Saturday morning, Tom goes to the shop with his sister. He looks at the books for a long time. He chooses a book about animals and pays for it. Now he has less money, but he is very happy.

questions.text: How often does Tom get pocket money?
What does Tom choose in the shop?
Why does Tom save some money in a small box?
options: He wants to save money for something important later
He wants to lose his money
He wants to give money to his sister

questions.text: How does Tom probably feel after he buys the book?

vocabulary.definition: gets something that is given to you

paragraph_translations: Tom her Cumartesi harçlık alır. Ailesinden beş pound alır. Bazı paralarını küçük bir kutuda biriktirmeyi sever. Bu hafta yeni bir kitap almak istiyor.
Cumartesi sabahı Tom kız kardeşiyle dükkâna gider. Kitaplara uzun süre bakar. Hayvanlar hakkında bir kitap seçer ve parasını öder. Artık daha az parası var, ama çok mutlu.
